status: the release binary since 2026-10-11 (branch feature/csmwrap-boot-disk): installer/cmd/usos-efisign/release.go stages it with the source archive, the five patches and the licence notices; tools/xp_csmwrap_esp.sh and the BIOS Core DOS installer pin its hash
naming: 3.1.2-usos4 = 3.1.2-usos3 + patch 0005 (boot disk by sector-0 hash). Earlier: usos2 was the failed system_thread_visible experiment, usos3 = usos1 + patch 0004.
modified: MODIFIED version of CSMWrap 3.1.2 and of its SeaBIOS fork: quiet boot unless csmwrap.ini sets verbose = true (patches 0001-0003, as in 3.1.2-usos1), and SeaBIOS CSM boot priorities looked up in CSMWrap's BBS table by PCI address, USB mass storage included (patch 0004, 2026-09-29); the exact disk CSMWrap was loaded from becomes BIOS drive 0x80 also when other disks share its controller (patch 0005, 2026-10-11: CSMWrap tags its BBS entry with an FNV-1a hash of its sector 0, SeaBIOS moves the matching hard disk first, the others keep their order)

source_archive.note: unpatched 3.1.2 tree with all submodules and seabios/.version (shared with 3.1.2-usos1); the usos3 source is this archive plus patches/*.patch applied in order with patch -p1

upstream_rebuild.note: the same source and toolchain built WITHOUT patches in each run: matches 3.1.2-usos1/manifest.json upstream_rebuild
